Coverage: Panamá. The portal files it under the publisher Ministerio de Desarrollo Agropecuario. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2020-11-19 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support irrigation network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
